name: CETC Chips Technology Inc.
summary: CETC Chips Technology Inc. is a company dedicated to the entire lifecycle of silicon-based analog semiconductor chips and their associated products. Its operations span from conceptual design and rigorous research and development to production, quality assurance testing, and global sales, serving markets both within the People's Republic of China and worldwide. The company's diverse product portfolio addresses various advanced technological sectors. Within the Internet of Things (IoT) domain, it provides a range of wireless communication solutions, including radio frequency (RF) amplifiers, switches, digital control attenuators, frequency synthesizers, and RF transceivers, alongside satellite navigation and short-range communication devices. For green energy applications, CETC Chips develops photovoltaic bypass switch circuits and comprehensive power management solutions. The security electronics sector benefits from their offerings, such as motor drive chips for surveillance systems, environmental monitoring circuits, and anti-counterfeit RFID tags and integrated systems. Furthermore, in automotive electronics, their contributions include satellite navigation System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions, Battery Management System (BMS) chips, high- and low-side electronic switches, half-bridge drivers, and LED driver ICs. Smart home technology is enhanced by their motor drive and electronic switch chip series, as well as intelligent electronic control units. In the realm of smart terminals, they contribute to the design of smart power supplies, wearable devices, and intelligent speaker products. The company, originally named CETC Acoustic-Optic-Electronic Technology Inc., adopted its current designation, CETC Chips Technology Inc., in October 2022. Established in 1875, CETC Chips Technology Inc. maintains its headquarters in Chongqing, People's Republic of China.
